newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA - HANSA LIISING TO OPEN MOSCOW OFFICE.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA - HANSA LIISING TO OPEN MOSCOW OFFICE.

text.p: Hansa Liising, the leasing subsidiary of Hansapank , said on Monday it plans to launch a leasing subsidiary in Moscow.
"We plan to open it in the nearest future," Hansa Liising's marketing manager, Margit Kirsipuu, told Reuters.
It will establish a subsidiary, which will be 100 percent owned by Hansa Liising, she added.
Kirsipuu said the company will not make any further comments until the office is opened.
Hansa Liising, the leader in the Estonian leasing market, already has subsidiaries in Latvia and Lithuania.
